entities.name: forked bare elm west of the farmhouses
entities.what: Bare elm-like tree (elm_claw form), about 520 px tall: one trunk rising from the ground in front of the west end of the westernmost thatched house, forking at about v 620 into two twisting stems; the west stem bends up-left into a broad flat crown of dark crab-claw twig clusters, the east stem turns into a long limb rising north-east to a second crab-claw head; a short side branch with claw twigs at about (33430-33510, 570-625). No leaves.
entities.vis: part: lower trunk crossed by the shoots of t4's low willow (base about 33095, 1040)
entities.note: Trunk contours 33420-33445 at v 700-900; fork at about (33415, 620): west stem 33357-33374, east stem 33391-33407 at v 500-590. West crown head about (33340, 455); east head (33485, 400-450). The ground line meets the trunk at v 900-910. Height foot-to-top 520 px.

entities.name: faint far tree behind the west house
entities.what: A faint, pale-inked far tree standing behind the westernmost thatched house: a thin pale trunk and a small crown of pale twigs, drawn much lighter than the trees in front (distance or mist).
entities.note: Read on a red-channel crop with raised contrast: pale trunk about 33430-33448 at v 493-684 (and a second faint line 33466-33494 that may be its other contour), pale twigs 33416-33480 at v 356-420, behind the east stem and crown of S1.tree.elm_forked_33433. Base est behind the west house (roof top v about 690). Could be silk wear rather than a tree; record kept so the merge can decide.

entities.name: tall bare elm behind the thatched house
entities.what: Tall bare elm-like tree (elm_claw form) standing behind the long thatched farmhouse: a straight slender trunk rising to a high flat crown of crab-claw twig clusters spread wide east and west, the crown reaching near the top of the grove. No leaves.
entities.vis: part: trunk foot hidden behind the thatched roof (the trunk stops at the roof's lower ridge line, v 770-780)
entities.note: Trunk contours 33540-33560 at v 490-775, bending to 33500-33530 at v 300-380 below the crown head (about 33545, 270). Base est just behind the house, below the ridge line where the trunk disappears; the true foot is north of the house. Painted height to the visible trunk end 541 px.

entities.name: bare elm behind the thatched house, east of the tall one
entities.what: Bare elm-like tree (elm_claw form) behind the long thatched farmhouse, its trunk drawn as two parallel contour lines rising to a rounded crown of crab-claw twigs lower than its tall neighbour's.
entities.vis: part: trunk foot hidden behind the thatched roof
entities.note: Trunk contours 33578 and 33602 at v 465-778, meeting the crown head at about (33605, 465). A thin third line at 33620-33630 (v 510-703) may be a second stem or a branch of it. Base est behind the house like S1.tree.elm_tall_33552 (40 px west). The two contour lines might instead be two thin trunks from one foot: either way one tree.

entities.name: faint far trunk behind the thatched house
entities.what: A faint, pale broad trunk with no dark outline standing behind the long thatched farmhouse between the two dark-trunked groups; a few small claw twigs at about (33690-33736, 553-607) may be its crown.
entities.note: Pale band 33705-33736 at v 585-790 on a red-channel crop, ending at the roof (roof top v about 700-720 here). Its crown is not separable from the crown of S1.tree.elm_forked_33785; the claw twigs may belong to that tree's west stem instead. A second pale band at 33750-33768 (v 600-790) is read as the pale middle of that tree's stem, not a tree.

entities.name: forked bare elm in front of the thatched house
entities.what: Bare elm-like tree (elm_claw form) in front of the long thatched farmhouse: one foot with roots spreading west, a short trunk forking low (about v 770) into two or three tall stems: the west stems rise and lean up-left to a crown of crab-claw twigs, the east stem rises up-right, then straight, to a higher crown. No leaves.
entities.note: Foot: pale trunk 33777-33797 from the fork (about 33790, 770) down to v 907, roots 33735-33800 at v 900-953. West stems 33762-33797 (v 420-770), their crown 33671-33787 at v 302-455 (top about 33740, 302); east stem rises from the fork up-right to (33830, 640), then 33808-33832 up to v 480, its crown 33782-33845 at v 265-370. Read at zoom 3 (red channel and natural): the east stem leaves the same fork (the restyle draws it so too); a reading as a separate tree behind the house was considered and dropped.

entities.name: tallest bare elm of the grove
entities.what: The tallest tree of the farmhouse grove: a long straight slender bare trunk (elm-like, slender with a crab-claw crown) rising from in front of the thatched farmhouse to a small high crown of crab-claw twigs near the top of the grove.
entities.note: Trunk 33847-33877 from v 213 to 890, curving to the foot at 33860-33873, v 907-953. Height 751 px. The crown's east twigs mix with the crown of S1.tree.elm_slender_33906.

entities.name: slender bare elm with a nest
entities.what: Slender bare tree (elm-like) rising straight in front of the thatched farmhouse to a crown that spreads up to the north-east in long crab-claw branches; a dark nest sits where its trunk ends among the top twigs (S1.prop.nest_33900).
entities.note: Trunk 33892-33917 from v 255 down to 913, foot 33900-33913 at v 913-940. Its foot touches that of S1.tree.elm_twin_33936 (31 px east): the two may be one three-stemmed clump. The nest at (33890-33910, 228-245) sits at the top of this trunk; it could belong to S1.tree.elm_tall_33865 (its crown top is 40 px west).

entities.name: two-stemmed bare elm, one stem leaning
entities.what: Bare elm-like tree (elm_claw form) with two stems from one foot in front of the thatched farmhouse: a near-vertical stem forking at about v 570 into a small crab-claw crown, and a long stem leaning north-east across the roof, crossing in front of the next tree's trunk at about (34025, 700) and rising to a fork at about (34010, 530) with its own crab-claw crown.
entities.vis: part: foot partly in the hatched brush at the house front
entities.note: Vertical stem 33939-33956 (v 560-820) curving west to the foot; leaning stem from (33947, 843) to (34013, 669), then vertical 34009-34030 to the fork at v 530. Foot shared or nearly shared with S1.tree.elm_slender_33906 (31 px west). The leaning stem could instead be the lower part of S1.tree.elm_spreading_34030 crossing; read on red-channel and natural crops at zoom 3, the pale band of 34030's trunk continues down to v 915 behind it.

entities.name: spreading bare elm at the yard's west side
entities.what: Large bare elm-like tree (elm_claw form) at the east end of the big thatched farmhouse: a straight trunk that sends two long heavy limbs east, level over the farmyard to about u 34430, hung with crab-claw twig sprays (one spray hangs low over the yard at about 34250-34390, v 690-770), and rises to a smaller crown above.
entities.vis: part: foot in the hatched thatch and brush at the house's east end
entities.note: Trunk pale band 34023-34040 at v 690-920 (red channel, zoom 3), upper trunk 34040-34057 at v 450-750. Lower limb leaves at about (34045, 655) and runs east through (34105, 580)-(34200, 600) to (34440, 640); upper limb from about (34140, 556) east to (34370, 515) (it may belong to S1.tree.elm_34110 instead). The low twig spray over the yard hangs from the lower limb at about (34285, 680). Base est where the trunk enters the brush.

entities.name: bare elm over the farmyard
entities.what: Bare elm-like tree (elm_claw form) standing at the west edge of the farmyard: a straight pale trunk forking high (about v 390) into branches that spread to a broad crown of crab-claw twigs; a pale perched bird (?) sits in its crown (S1.ani.pale_bird_34250).
entities.vis: part: foot hidden by the small thatched shed and brush at the yard's west side
entities.note: Trunk 34100-34150, slanting slightly from the foot (about 34110, 900) up to the fork at (34148, 390). The pale stem visible down to v 890 at 34100-34118, then brush. Height 603 px.

entities.name: nest at the top of the slender elm
entities.what: A dark round nest (or a perched dark bird) among the top twigs of the slender elm, about 20 x 17 px of solid ink with a bluish tinge.
entities.note: Extents (33890-33910, 228-245). Read as a nest (a solid round mass in a fork, typical of the painter's bare trees); a crow would be an animal: S4 recorded a similar blot as S4.ani.bird_12433. The tree it sits in is read as S1.tree.elm_slender_33906; S1.tree.elm_tall_33865's crown is 40 px west.

entities.name: pale bird (?) perched in the elm's crown
entities.what: A small pale whitish-grey oval shape with a darker bluish top, upright among the crown twigs of the elm over the farmyard: read as a perched pale bird (a dove or egret?), body upright, head at the top.
entities.note: Extents (34238-34262, 305-345), about 20 x 40 px. Both readings: a perched pale bird, or a pale abrasion/white pigment on the silk at the crown head (the restyle draws only twigs here). Recorded so the merge can settle it at zoom 3.

entities.name: stone roller in its frame (?) on the threshing floor
entities.what: Idle on the open floor behind the farmhouse: a dark round mass (read as the stone of a threshing roller, 碌碡) held in a pale wooden frame that curves round its west side, with a short peg standing up at the top and a pale squared bar sticking out at the bottom east.
entities.src: 名画记: 寂静的谷场 (pin 2)
entities.note: Extents u 34127-34196, v 690-765 (about 65 x 70 px; the pale bar at the east end is faint). Both readings: a stone roller in its drag frame (the threshing floor is 寂静的谷场, pin 2 at 34100: idle, no work done), or a figure in a dark robe carrying a wheel or barrow (the restyle draws a man in blue holding a wheel here; no head, face or feet show on the scan). It stands on plain silk north of the yard's fence rail (v 811-818), i.e. on the floor behind the house.

entities.name: bending figure at the yard's fence
entities.what: A small figure with a rounded, hooded back bent forward, seen from behind at the east end of the yard's fence rail, working at the ground among low objects; no limbs or face readable.
entities.src: 名画记: 寂静的谷场 (pin 2)
entities.note: Shape 34237-34270, v 810-868: a rounded arch outlined in dark ink, its left side straight, its right side shaded; painted height 56 px (a bending adult at this v; the charcoal driver at v 930 stands about 100 px). Both readings: a bending farmer (the setup's reading), or a bell-shaped thing (an upturned hen basket, a small straw stack). The fence rail (structures_e's) ends at its top-left.

entities.name: low dark object at the shed's foot
entities.what: A low dark object under the east hip end of S1.bld.farmhouse_thatched_33955, by its corner post, darker at its west end, with pale spots: a basket, a heap, or a hen.
entities.note: Extents 34152-34190, v 852-872 (bluish-green tinted ink). Readings: a basket or heap set down; a hen or a lying dog (west end like a head). Not settled at zoom 4.

entities.name: low elongated object in the farmyard
entities.what: A low elongated object with a pale middle, pointed at its east end, with two thin sticks standing just above it: a trough or a flat basket, or a hen.
entities.note: Extents 34190-34227, v 846-860; thin uprights at (34203-34208, 835-848). A dark dash below at 34209-34230, v 876-883 is read as a ground stroke, not a thing.

entities.name: domed haystack (or small roof) behind the big farmhouse
entities.what: A rounded dark dome with a smooth top and a straight west side, standing behind the east end of the big thatched farmhouse at the edge of the floor: read as a haystack, or the end of a small thatched roof.
entities.vis: part: lower half hidden by the big thatched roof and two tree trunks
entities.note: Outline: west side 34062 from v 705 down to 765, top (34078-34095, 697), east end behind S1.tree.elm_34110's trunk at about 34100. The restyle draws a thatched roof. If structures_e records it as a building, drop this prop. MERGE: structures_e recorded the same dome as the building S1.bld.small_round_roof_34080 (dark hatched dome u 34064-34097, v 700-725; a thin vertical stroke at u ~34066 down to v ~745 that may be a post; readings: a small round thatched shelter on a post, or the top of a straw stack); that building is retired and this prop kept. On the merge's zoom-2 crop the dome has a smooth top, a straight west side and no eave fringe or wall under it, which reads as a stack. If the second pass finds the post and an eave, it becomes a small shelter again (a building). SECOND PASS (farms): no post or eave found (dome_n.jpg zoom 3, dome_hp.jpg zoom 4, roller_z4.jpg). The dome's top arc runs from (34063, 715) over (34085, 700) to (34100, 698). Its west side comes down to (34063, 745), where it meets the east hip slope of S1.bld.farmhouse_thatched_33955 (34060, 743) -> (34107, 790). Below the arc there is no open space and no shaft: the 'vertical stroke at ~34066 down to v ~745' is the dome's own west side ending on the slope. Its foot is hidden behind the big house's roof. It stays a stack (or the top of a roof behind the house), conf low.

entities.name: the quiet farmyard
entities.what: The farmyard at the east end of the big thatched farmhouse (寂静的谷场): a single bending figure at the fence with two low objects under the big farmhouse's east hip end; behind the fence the floor lies empty but for the idle roller (S1.prop.roller_frame_34158).
entities.src: 名画记: 寂静的谷场 (pin 2)
entities.note: The 'small shed' at the yard's west side (hatched gable 34117-34155, v 805-852, a post at 34140-34148 down to v 885) is the east hip end of S1.bld.farmhouse_thatched_33955 and its corner post (second pass); the fence rail (34122, 811)->(34235, 818) is S1.str.rail_34170. Behind the rail, the roller stands on the open floor S1.grd.floor_behind_yard_34285 (if accepted).
